criteria.supports: The excerpt asserts, from the source's OWN evidence or its own system's behaviour, that the claim holds: some verification step exists and is separate from the component whose output it checks. A general assertion, not one fenced to a named subset.
criteria.contradicts: The excerpt asserts, from the source's OWN evidence, that the claim does not hold: either no verification step exists, or the checking is performed by the same component (or the same model, or the same process) that produced the output. Self-review counts as contradicting, because the claim is about independence, not about the existence of review.
criteria.qualifies: The excerpt neither asserts nor denies the claim in general, but narrows it: it holds for a named subset (some outputs, some stages, some configuration), or under a stated condition, or only as far as the source's own evidence reaches. A finding hedged to its own test conditions belongs here.
criteria.contextualizes: The excerpt bears on the subject matter but takes no position on the claim: a definition, a background measurement, a count, a description of the field, or a statement about something adjacent.

label_provenance.account: NOT A GOLD STANDARD. The twenty invented cases of mb-cls-v1-synthetic carried over unchanged in label and prediction — so N1-T02 AT1's hand-computed oracle still holds exactly — plus criteria-v2 fields: decided_by on every case, tie_with on three, and three new undecidable cases that exercise the coverage path. The real standard is set by an encounter with another practice and will arrive as its own file.

notes: 23 cases: 20 decidable (supports 10, contradicts 5, qualifies 3, contextualizes 2) and 3 undecidable. Scored against mb-cls-v2.synthetic.predictions.json the matrix is unchanged from v1 — [[8,1,1,0],[1,3,1,0],[1,0,2,0],[1,0,0,1]], accuracy 0.70, majority baseline 0.50, Cohen's kappa exactly 17/32, false-support 0.30 — because the undecidable cases are excluded from it rather than absorbed into it. 3 tie-broken, 3 undecidable, both reported.
